user.title: Set up IR heating
user.description: A thermostat for one or more switched heaters in one room. Temperatures, PV boost, season and controller settings follow under Configure.

data_description.heaters: All selected switches are cycled together.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Keep it out of the panels' radiation and out of the sun.

abort.already_configured: This sensor already has a thermostat.

data_description.eco_temp: Applies whenever nothing else is active. Below 16 °C an attic risks condensation.

data_description.override_minutes: How long comfort or a manually set temperature lasts before automatic mode returns.
data_description.latest_end: Ends at this time at the latest, if it is still ahead today. Leave empty for no fixed end.

pv_boost.title: PV boost
pv_boost.description: Heats with surplus that would otherwise go to the grid. The car comes first: no boost while it charges. Signs as in evcc: grid positive = import, battery positive = discharge.

data.boost_stop_import: Stop at draw from grid and battery of

season.title: Heating limit
season.description: When the outdoor average (moving, about 24 h) is above the limit, the thermostat holds no eco temperature and there is no PV boost. Comfort by button still works.

data_description.kp: 60 means: 1 K below target gives 60 % heating power.
data_description.refresh_minutes: 0 = never. With an auto-off timer on the switch, the heater then only goes off when Home Assistant fails.

error.min_above_max: The lowest value must be below the highest.
error.target_out_of_range: Eco, comfort and boost must lie between the lowest and highest value.
error.boost_needs_grid: PV boost needs the grid power sensor.
